site.audience: developers building apps, themes, storefronts, and AI agents for an ecommerce platform

brief.title: CommerceForge Dev Docs — Build for the Commerce Platform
brief.one_liner: A developer documentation hub for building apps, storefronts, and AI-powered shopping agents on a leading ecommerce platform.
brief.goal: Guide developers through building, customizing, and launching apps, themes, headless storefronts, and agentic commerce experiences with clear documentation, CLI tooling instructions, and community resources.

pages.objective: Introduce the developer platform, highlight the three main product areas (Apps, Storefronts, Agents), showcase CLI quick-start, and provide launch and community resources.
Provide a comprehensive overview of building apps, including dev tools, extensible surfaces, building blocks (APIs, webhooks, functions), use cases, and best practices.
Present storefront building options including managed themes with a templating language, headless commerce APIs, mobile SDKs, and platform extension points.
Introduce agentic commerce capabilities, explain the Universal Commerce Protocol, and guide developers through product discovery and checkout integration for AI agents.
Direct developers to community support, partner program documentation, and contact channels for non-technical assistance.
